#Load libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
```

#Import Run document and set marker lookup info
```{r}

imported_runPlateMaps <- read_xlsx("/Users/mcallister/Desktop/Run6_AlaskaArctic_SmithRoot_Beads_PCR_Sequencing Plate Maps.xlsx", sheet = "Sequencing Plate Maps for JV", col_names = FALSE)

export_locname <- "/Users/mcallister/Downloads/Run6_longFormat.xlsx"

imported_runPlateMaps <- imported_runPlateMaps %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character))

marker_map <- tibble(
  designation = c(
    "MiFish",
    "18S v4",
    "ITS",
    "Leray COI",
    "16S Fuhrman",
    "18S v9"
  ),
  marker = c(
    "MiFish 12S",
    "18S V4",
    "ITS Marker",
    "Leray CO1",
    "16S Fuhrman",
    "18S V9"
  )
)

```

#Functions
```{r}
get_cell <- function(x, row, col) {

  if (
    row < 1 ||
    col < 1 ||
    row > nrow(x) ||
    col > ncol(x)
  ) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  x[[col]][row]
}

matches_sequence <- function(x, expected) {

  length(x) == length(expected) &&
    all(
      !is.na(x) &
        trimws(x) == as.character(expected)
    )
}

is_plate_geometry <- function(row, col, x) {

  # Need enough room for:
  #   12 columns to the right
  #   8 rows below
  if (row + 8 > nrow(x) || col + 12 > ncol(x)) {
    return(FALSE)
  }

  # Expected column headers: 1 through 12
  column_headers <- x[row, (col + 1):(col + 12)]

  # Expected row headers: A through H
  row_headers <- x[(row + 1):(row + 8), col]

  columns_numeric <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(column_headers)
  )

  columns_ok <- all(
    !is.na(columns_numeric) &
      columns_numeric == 1:12
  )

  rows_ok <- all(
    !is.na(row_headers) &
      row_headers == LETTERS[1:8]
  )

  columns_ok && rows_ok
}
```

#Detect plate starts
```{r}
# ============================================================
# FIND 96-WELL PLATE GEOMETRY
# ============================================================

# Convert to a character matrix
x <- as.matrix(imported_runPlateMaps)

# Remove whitespace from all cells
x <- trimws(x)


potential_plates <- expand_grid(
  row = 1:(nrow(x) - 8),
  col = 1:(ncol(x) - 12)
) %>%
  mutate(

    plate_label = x[cbind(row, col)],

    column_headers = map2(
      row, col,
      ~ x[.x, (.y + 1):(.y + 12)]
    ),

    row_headers = map2(
      row, col,
      ~ x[(.x + 1):(.x + 8), .y]
    ),

    columns_ok = map_lgl(
      column_headers,
      ~ {
        z <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))
        all(!is.na(z) & z == 1:12)
      }
    ),

    rows_ok = map_lgl(
      row_headers,
      ~ all(.x == LETTERS[1:8])
    )

  ) %>%
  filter(columns_ok, rows_ok)


plate_geometry_qc <- potential_plates %>%
  mutate(
    plate_label = trimws(plate_label),

    valid_plate_label = str_detect(
      plate_label,
      "^P[0-9]+$|^MU$"
    ),

    problem = case_when(
      is.na(plate_label) ~ "Missing plate label",
      plate_label == "" ~ "Blank plate label",
      !valid_plate_label ~ "Unexpected plate label",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


geometry_problems <- plate_geometry_qc %>%
  filter(!valid_plate_label) %>%
  select(
    row,
    col,
    plate_label,
    problem
  )


if (nrow(geometry_problems) > 0) {

  print(geometry_problems)

} else {

  message(
    "Plate geometry QC passed: ",
    nrow(potential_plates),
    " 96-well plates detected; all have P## or MU labels."
  )

}

```

#Create Table of Detected Valid Plates
```{r}

plate_blocks <- plate_geometry_qc %>%
  filter(valid_plate_label) %>%
  arrange(row, col) %>%
  transmute(
    `Plate Number` = row_number(),
    `Plate Set` = plate_label,
    header_row = row,
    header_col = col
  )


plate_blocks

```

#Identify the marker well identifier
```{r}

find_marker_designation <- function(header_row, header_col, x) {

  # Last row occupied by the 96-well plate
  well_end_row <- header_row + 8

  # Columns occupied by the plate, including the row-label
  # column
  plate_cols <- header_col:(header_col + 12)

  # Search downward from the first row below the plate.
  #
  # Stop before the next possible plate header if one occurs.
  search_rows <- (well_end_row + 1):nrow(x)

  # Search only within the plate's horizontal footprint
  for (r in search_rows) {

    vals <- x[r, plate_cols]

    # Look for a cell containing "Sequencing"
    hits <- which(
      !is.na(vals) &
        str_detect(
          vals,
          regex("^OME\\s+.*Sequencing", ignore_case = TRUE)
        )
    )

    if (length(hits) > 0) {

      return(
        tibble(
          marker_row = r,
          marker_col = plate_cols[hits[1]],
          sequencing_designation = vals[hits[1]]
        )
      )
    }

    # If another plate starts before finding a marker,
    # stop searching this plate.
    #
    # We look for the characteristic 1:12 headers and
    # A:H row headers at the same horizontal positions.

    if (r <= nrow(x) - 8) {

      next_plate <- tryCatch(
        is_plate_geometry(
          row = r,
          col = header_col,
          x = x
        ),
        error = function(e) FALSE
      )

      if (next_plate) {
        break
      }
    }
  }

  # No designation found
  tibble(
    marker_row = NA_integer_,
    marker_col = NA_integer_,
    sequencing_designation = NA_character_
  )
}


# ============================================================
# Apply to every detected plate
# ============================================================

plate_markers <- plate_blocks %>%
  mutate(
    marker_info = map2(
      header_row,
      header_col,
      ~ find_marker_designation(
        header_row = .x,
        header_col = .y,
        x = x
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  unnest(marker_info)

# ============================================================
# STEP 3: NORMALIZE MARKER NAME
# ============================================================

plate_markers <- plate_markers %>%
  mutate(

    # Remove the plate-specific portion:
    #
    # OME P30 Sequencing MiFish
    # -> MiFish
    #
    # OME P38 Sequencing 18S v9
    # -> 18S v9

    marker_designation = str_remove(
      sequencing_designation,
      regex("^OME\\s+P[0-9]+\\s+Sequencing\\s+", 
            ignore_case = TRUE)
    ),

    # MU plates need the same treatment, if their designation
    # follows the same OME ... Sequencing pattern.
    marker_designation = str_remove(
      marker_designation,
      regex("^OME\\s+RUN 6 Makeups\\s+Sequencing\\s+",
            ignore_case = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    marker_key = marker_designation %>%
      str_squish() %>%
      str_to_lower()
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    marker_map %>%
      mutate(
        marker_key = designation %>%
          str_squish() %>%
          str_to_lower()
      ),
    by = "marker_key"
  ) %>%
  select(-marker_key)

plate_markers
```

#Extract and convery to long format
```{r}
# ============================================================
# STEP 9: EXTRACT EACH 8 × 12 PLATE
# ============================================================

extract_plate_wells <- function(
  `Plate Number`,
  `Plate Set`,
  header_row,
  header_col,
  marker,
  x
) {

  # Extract the 8 × 12 sample area.
  #
  # The plate header is at:
  #   header_row, header_col
  #
  # The 96 wells are:
  #   rows    header_row + 1 through header_row + 8
  #   columns header_col + 1 through header_col + 12

  sample_matrix <- x[
    (header_row + 1):(header_row + 8),
    (header_col + 1):(header_col + 12),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  # Convert the 8 × 12 matrix into one row per well.
  #
  # as.vector(t(...)) reads across each row:
  #
  # A1, A2, ... A12,
  # B1, B2, ... B12,
  # ...
  # H1, H2, ... H12

  expand_grid(
    Row = LETTERS[1:8],
    Column = 1:12
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      `Sample Name` = as.vector(t(sample_matrix)),
      `Plate Number` = `Plate Number`,
      `Plate Set` = `Plate Set`,
      `Metabarcoding Marker` = marker
    ) %>%
    select(
      `Plate Number`,
      `Plate Set`,
      `Metabarcoding Marker`,
      Row,
      Column,
      `Sample Name`
    )
}


# ============================================================
# EXTRACT ALL DETECTED PLATES
# ============================================================

plate_wells <- pmap_dfr(
  plate_markers %>%
    select(
      `Plate Number`,
      `Plate Set`,
      header_row,
      header_col,
      marker
    ),
  extract_plate_wells,
  x = x
)

# ============================================================
# STEP 10: CREATE PLATE NAME
# ============================================================

plate_wells <- plate_wells %>%
  mutate(
    `Plate Name` = paste(
      "OME",
      `Plate Set`,
      "Sequencing",
      `Metabarcoding Marker`
    ),
    .after = `Plate Set`
  )

# ============================================================
# STEP 11: ASSIGN LIBRARY NUMBERS
# ============================================================

plate_wells <- plate_wells %>%
  arrange(
    `Plate Number`,
    Row,
    Column
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Library Number` = if_else(
      !is.na(`Sample Name`) &
        `Sample Name` != "" &
        str_to_upper(`Sample Name`) != "EMPTY",
      cumsum(
        !is.na(`Sample Name`) &
          `Sample Name` != "" &
          str_to_upper(`Sample Name`) != "EMPTY"
      ),
      NA_integer_
    ),
    .before = 1
  )


plate_wells

```

#Create final long format library table for export
```{r}
# ============================================================
# STEP 12: CREATE FINAL LIBRARY TABLE
# ============================================================

library_table <- plate_wells %>%
  select(
    `Library Number`,
    `Plate Number`,
    `Plate Set`,
    `Metabarcoding Marker`,
    `Plate Name`,
    Column,
    Row,
    `Sample Name`
  )


library_table



```

#Export
```{r}
write_xlsx(
  library_table,
  export_locname,
  na = "NA"
)
```
